description: Bitcoin daily candles in US dollars, UTC days: open, high, low, close. Complete days only.
notes: Each row names its source. Where a second source covers the day its close is given as check_close; a difference above 1.5% is flagged ("flag": "close-differs") and both values are kept. The second source covers about the last 720 days at the first run and every day from then on.
